meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Viet Nam (nationwide, no separate sub-state tax or registry jurisdiction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Socialist legal system with administrative law elements)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Agreement between Viet Nam and Japan for the Liberalisation, Promotion and Protection of Investment (2003)
Agreement between the Government of the Republic of Korea and the Government of the Socialist Republic of Viet Nam on the Promotion and Protection of Investment (2003)
EU-Viet Nam Free Trade Agreement (EVFTA, including investment protection)
Comprehensive and Progressive Agreement for Trans-Pacific Partnership (CPTPP)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Law on Anti-Money Laundering No. 02/2022/QH15, effective 1 March 2023; Decree No. 10/2023/NĐ-CP detailing AML/CFT measures; Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN on AML/CFT for financial institutions; Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14; Decree No. 01/2021/NĐ-CP on enterprise registration (as amended by Decree No. 122/2021/NĐ-CP) requiring disclosure of beneficial owners; Penal Code No. 100/2015/QH13 on money laundering and terrorist financing offences.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (beneficial ownership information is filed with the national enterprise registration authority and is accessible to competent authorities, not published for general public inspection)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation / Business Registration Certificate of Foreign Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry in the shareholder's country of incorporation
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (if origin country is a contracting state to the Apostille Convention) OR Consular Legalization at the relevant Vietnamese Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Passport of Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) and Authorized Signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority of the respective country (passport photo page)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized copy + Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization; statutory declaration of authenticity for Vietnamese authorities

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Power of Attorney to the Vietnamese Law Firm / Incorporation Agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign corporate shareholder and UBO, executed before a competent notary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization of the notarized original

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter / Certificate of Good Standing from Foreign Bank
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign banking institution where the shareholder maintains an account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization (notarization may be required by the receiving bank in Viet Nam)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Articles of Association / Charter of Foreign Corporate Shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Foreign company registry or corporate secretary
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Certified copy plus Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, managers, and authorized representatives against the domestic PEP list under Law No. 02/2022/QH15, OFAC SDN List, UN Security Council consolidated sanctions lists, EU/UK designated persons lists, and Viet Nam's national counter-terrorist financing lists. Enhanced due diligence (EDD) is required for all PEPs, high-risk jurisdictions, and foreign trust relationships. The risk-based approach must align with FATF Recommendations and Circular No. 09/2023/TT-NHNN.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: National Business Registration Portal (Cổng thông tin quốc gia về đăng ký doanh nghiệp) - https://dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The enterprise name must be written in Vietnamese orthography, using the Vietnamese alphabet, digits, and allowable symbols. A foreign enterprise name may appear in parentheses or brackets after the statutory Vietnamese name. The name must contain two elements: the enterprise type (Công ty trách nhiệm hữu hạn / LLC) and the individual legal name. Names must not contravene Vietnamese social ethics, national security, or public order, and must not be identical or confusingly similar to an existing enterprise name on the National Business Registration Portal.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Ngân hàng (Bank) - restricted under Law on Credit Institutions
Bảo hiểm (Insurance) - restricted under Law on Insurance Business
Chứng khoán (Securities) - restricted under Securities Law
Tín thác (Trust) - sensitive token requiring special sectoral license
Quỹ (Fund) - restricted for collective investment schemes
Khủng bố (Terrorism) or other words violating national security
Vulgar or offensive expressions under Vietnamese social norms
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Viet Nam does not provide a separate advance name-reservation mechanism; the proposed name is reviewed as part of the enterprise registration dossier and, if approved, is fixed upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate. If the name is rejected, the enterprise registration agency must state the specific grounds in writing. The applicant has the right to amend the proposed name and resubmit the corrected dossier without additional government filing fees within the prescribed response period. Administrative appeals may be lodged with the Director of the Department of Planning and Investment of the province within 30 days of rejection, and further appeals to the Minister of Planning and Investment under Law No. 02/2011/QH13 on Complaints. Judicial remedies are available before the Administrative Court under Law No. 93/2015/QH13 on Administrative Procedures.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A purely virtual office is not permissible for a foreign-invested LLC engaged in fiduciary administration of irrevocable offshore spendthrift trusts (ISIC 6430). The enterprise must maintain a physical registered head office address in Viet Nam, with visible operational capacity, staff, and systems to satisfy AML/CFT supervision and financial licensing conditions. Virtual office services may only supplement a full physical office and cannot serve as the sole registered address.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: High - approximately 80% to 85% probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection during the first 12 months of licensed fiduciary operations under supervisory practice of the State Bank of Viet Nam and the Ministry of Finance.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Law on Enterprises No. 59/2020/QH14 (Articles 25-27 on incorporation procedure, Article 28 on conditional business lines, Articles 46-49 on multi-member limited liability companies, and Article 188 on foreign investment conditions); Decree No. 01/2021/ND-CP on enterprise registration; Circular No. 02/2019/TT-BKHDT on enterprise registration forms; Law on Credit Institutions No. 47/2010/QH13 as amended, and State Bank of Vietnam regulations governing fiduciary and trust management activities.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Business Registration Office, Department of Planning and Investment of the province/city where the registered head office is located, operating under the Ministry of Planning and Investment through the National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Enterprise Registration Dossier (Hồ sơ đăng ký doanh nghiệp), comprising the written Application for Enterprise Registration (Form Giấy đề nghị đăng ký doanh nghiệp), company charter, member list, and supporting legal documents, filed online or in person with the provincial Business Registration Office.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: There is no statutory minimum charter capital under Vietnamese general enterprise law for a standard limited liability company; however, if the company will provide fiduciary trust administration services, the State Bank of Vietnam may require a higher legal capital and escrow/deposit maintenance under its special licensing conditions. The member(s) must fully contribute their committed charter capital within 90 days from the date the Enterprise Registration Certificate is issued, and capital used for trust administration must be segregated from client assets held in escrow accounts.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en:
FIRST MEMBERS' (BOARD) RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME] LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANY.

RESOLVED, at the inaugural general meeting of members, held this day _________________, at _________________, Vietnam:

1. Capital Subscription and Contribution: The charter capital of the Company shall be VND ________________________________ (in words: _____________________________), divided among the members in the proportions stated in the Company Charter. Each member severally confirms subscription to his/her/its respective capital portion and irrevocably undertakes to pay such capital portion in full within ninety (90) days from issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, in accordance with Article 47 of the Law on Enterprises 2020.

2. Adoption of Registered Office: The registered head office of the Company shall be situated at _________________ (address), Vietnam. The legal representative is hereby authorized to execute, sign and file all lease or occupancy documents necessary to establish such address as the Company's registered office and to submit such particulars to the provincial Business Registration Office.

3. Election and Appointment of Officers: The meeting resolves to appoint _________________ as Chairperson of the Members' Council and _________________ as General Director (Chief Executive Officer) of the Company. Each appointee accepts office and shall have full authority to (a) execute and file the Enterprise Registration Dossier, (b) open bank accounts, (c) obtain tax registration, and (d) perform all lawful acts necessary for the incorporation and governance of the Company, subject to the Law on Enterprises 2020 and the Company Charter.

4. Regulatory Licensing: The General Director is directed to cause the Company to prepare and file all special license applications required for fiduciary trust administration activities, including the license application to the State Bank of Vietnam under applicable Credit Institutions and trust-management regulations. No revenue-generating trust activity may commence prior to issuance of such special license.

5. Segregation of Client Assets: The meeting resolves that any and all client trust funds, irrevocable offshore spendthrift trust assets, and escrow accounts shall be held separately from Company assets, maintained through designated fiduciary trust accounts, and administered solely in accordance with lawful fiduciary instructions and anti-money laundering obligations.

This Resolution shall be effective immediately and is signed by all members or authorized representatives.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Investment Registration Division, Department of Planning and Investment of the province/city where the project will operate, using the National Foreign Investment Information System (FDI Online).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the Investment Project Proposal, specifically describing the intended scope of fiduciary administration of irrevocable offshore spendthrift trusts. If the contemplated trust management activity is subject to special investment conditions, first obtain preliminary written approval of eligibility from the State Bank of Vietnam or the competent sectoral authority. Submit the full dossier through the FDI Online portal or file physically at the One-Stop Shop of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment. Pay the project processing charge, track the dossier status, and collect the Investment Registration Certificate once issued.
required_dossiers: Application for Investment Project Registration (Form A-I of Decree 01/2021/ND-CP)
Certified copy of investor passport or certificate of incorporation and audited financial statements
Investment project proposal stating objectives, scale, investment capital, and schedule
Trust company business plan and fiduciary compliance manual
Preliminary approval by State Bank of Vietnam or other competent ministry if conditional investment
Documents evidencing legal status and domicile of the investor
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the dossier is deemed incomplete, the investor has 30 working days to supplement. If the investment is refused, the investor may request a written refusal, file a complaint with the Director of the provincial Department of Planning and Investment, or petition the administrative court within the statutory time limits.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and Legalization of Constitutive Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Notary Public Office (under the Department of Justice) or digital notarization via VNeID e-signature for Vietnamese executed documents.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Company Charter, Members' List, capital contribution agreement, and meeting minutes in English and Vietnamese. Convene the founding members meeting, adopt the first board resolution, and cause all signatures to be notarized. Certify apostilled or consular-legalized translations of foreign corporate documents and passport pages. The final Vietnamese notarized charter and founding minutes will be used in the enterprise registration application.
required_dossiers: Draft Company Charter in Vietnamese and English
List of members and their respective capital contribution amounts
Idea of capital contribution and initial board resolution
Notarized lease agreement or letter of intent for the registered office
Legal representative's identification documents and notarized specimen signature
Apostilled or consular-legalized foreign corporate documents (for foreign corporate members)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary returns any document for correction, the founders may correct clerical errors and resubmit. If the notary refuses to certify due to deficient corporate authorization, obtain a fresh board resolution from the foreign investor and resubmit to the same or another notary public.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of Enterprise Registration Dossier via National Business Registration Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal (dangkykinhdoanh.gov.vn) and provincial Business Registration Office, Department of Planning and Investment.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Access the National Business Registration Portal using the VNeID identification code of the legal representative. Complete the Electronic Enterprise Registration Application, upload all notarized constitutive documents, and attach the Investment Registration Certificate. E-sign the submission through the portal. The system will provide an official request number and transmit the dossier to the provincial Business Registration Office where the registered office is located.
required_dossiers: Application for Enterprise Registration (Form signed digitally)
Notarized Company Charter
Notarized Members' List
Notarized First Board Resolution and minutes
Investment Registration Certificate (for foreign-invested company)
Notarized passport/legal representative identity documents
Authorization documents for third-party filers, if applicable
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Business Registration Office sends a notice of correction, the applicant must supplement and resubmit through the portal within 30 operating days. If the registration is rejected, the applicant may submit a formal objection to the Director of the Business Registration Office or to the Ministry of Planning and Investment, and may later bring an administrative suit. The enterprise remains legally unformed until a Certificate is issued.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of State Fees and Issuance of Enterprise Registration Certificate
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Provincial Business Registration Office and State Treasury/online payment gateway integrated with the National Business Registration Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, pay the enterprise registration state fee equal to approximately USD 4.25 (VND 100,000) through the permitted electronic payment channel or treasury receipt. The Business Registration Office will issue the Enterprise Registration Certificate (Giấy chứng nhận đăng ký doanh nghiệp) electronically and physically. Verify that the legal name, address, members, legal representative, and charter capital recorded in the Certificate are accurate.
required_dossiers: Online payment receipt or treasury voucher
Valid dossier reference number issued by the National Business Registration Portal
Identity document of the legal representative for physical collection
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the issued Certificate contains any material error, file an application for rectification with the issuing Business Registration Office accompanied by supporting exhibits. In case of excessive fee collection, request a refund from the State Treasury and invoke the complaint procedure under the Law on Complaints No. 02/2011/QH13.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Public Registration Announcement and Publication on National Enterprise Information Portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: National Business Registration Portal and National Enterprise Information Portal.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After incorporation, cause the Company to publish the enterprise registration contents on the National Enterprise Information Portal within 30 days from the date of issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate, in accordance with Article 34 of the Law on Enterprises 2020. The publication must contain the charter, full members' list, and registered business lines, especially noting the conditional fiduciary trust administration scope.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Notarized Company Charter
Members' List
Special condition approval documents from the State Bank of Vietnam, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Portal returns an access or data deficiency notice, promptly correct the data and resubmit the exact publication within 48 hours. Should any third party challenge the published contents, the Company may file a written explanation to the Portal administrator and the provincial Business Registration Office for record.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Compliance: Seal Notification, Tax Registration, Trust Account Opening, and Labor/Local Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security agency (provincial police) for seal notification; local Tax Sub-Department for tax registration; State Bank of Vietnam licensed bank for fiduciary account opening; Department of Science, Technology and Environment / provincial Department of Industrial Safety for workplace clearances.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Notify the seal specimen to the provincial Public Security administrative service or via the national seal service portal, open the Committee's capital account and a separate segregated fiduciary trust settlement account at a licensed credit institution or branch, obtain the tax code registration, register with the social insurance agency, and before commencing trust administration, obtain the special State Bank license for fiduciary trust operations. Also conduct the workplace occupancy and environmental self-assessment appropriate for a licensed trust-administration office.
required_dossiers: Enterprise Registration Certificate
Certificate of seal registration or seal notification receipt
Lease certificate / building occupancy certificate of the registered office
Tax registration form and legal representative's ID
Anti-money laundering policy and designated compliance officer appointment
Financial capacity statements for the special license requirement, if any
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If any post-formation clearance is delayed, the Company must continue to operate exclusively within permitted corporate housekeeping acts. File remedial applications with the respective authority and, if a statutory period is exceeded without action, engage the administrative complaint procedure under the Law on Handling of Administrative Violations, or petition the competent court.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: State Bank of Vietnam (SBV), Non-Bank Credit Institutions and Financial Supervision Department, acting as the special financial-industrial licensing authority for fiduciary trust administration and asset-protection trust services, in coordination with the provincial Department of Planning and Investment for the physical registered office and the Ministry of Public Security for workplace security.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: License to Establish and Conduct Fiduciary Administration of Discretionary Asset Protection Trusts (Giấy phép hoạt động quản lý và thực hiện ủy thác lòng tin vì mục đích bảo toàn tài sản), issued by the State Bank of Vietnam after the enterprise obtains its Enterprise Registration Certificate.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Natural Resources and Environment (DONRE) of the province/city where the registered office is located, under the Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MONRE).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Administrative office use for fiduciary trust management: Category III — Low / Exempt from a full Environmental Impact Assessment; only an Environmental Protection License (Giấy phép môi trường) prior to operation is required under Decree No. 08/2022/ND-CP, unless the company also contains physical vault, storage, or data-recording facilities with industrial backup generators, in which case an environmental registration or full report may be required.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharged from washing, sanitary, and kitchen facilities must meet National Technical Regulation on Domestic Wastewater, QCVN 14:2008/BTNMT, before entering the municipal sewerage system; volatile organic compound emissions from office equipment and cleaning agents must be controlled below the General Construction Ventilation standard (QCVN 06:2021/BXD) and OSHA workplace limits; solid waste must be segregated in accordance with Circular No. 02/2022/TT-BTNMT and non-hazardous household waste must be handled under the municipal waste collection plan; hazardous electronic and data-storage waste must be registered and contracted to a licensed hazardous waste treatment enterprise.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Design Appraisal Certification and/or Fire Safety Certificate of Satisfactory Operation issued by the Provincial Fire Police Department (Ministry of Public Security) verifying fire alarm, suppression, and evacuation compliance under Law on Fire Prevention and Fighting No. 27/2001/QH10 as amended; structural load inspection certificate from the Provincial Department of Construction confirming the floor load capacity for vault and server rooms pursuant to Construction Law No. 50/2014/QH13; workplace labor-safety clearance and occupational health assessment under Labor Code No. 45/2019/QH13, including annual environmental monitoring, emergency lamp and exit signage verification, and designated first-aid facilities.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: General Department of Taxation (Tổng cục Thuế) of the Ministry of Finance, Socialist Republic of Viet Nam; national e-tax portal — https://etax.gdt.gov.vn; e-invoice portal — https://hoadondientu.gdt.gov.vn; tax registration/TIN lookup — https://tracuunnt.gdt.gov.vn.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-invested Viet Nam Limited Liability Company obtains its Tax Identification Number (TIN; Mã số thuế) automatically upon issuance of the Enterprise Registration Certificate and Investment Registration Certificate by the provincial Department of Planning and Investment. The LLC must activate tax obligations and submit the tax/accounting registration dossier electronically via the GDT e-tax portal within 10 working days after enterprise registration. The 10-digit TIN serves as the VAT identification number; separate VAT ID certificates are not issued. Branches/dependent accounting units obtain 13-digit sub-TINs. A foreign contractor without a permanent establishment is not issued a full TIN; the Vietnamese payer instead applies the foreign contractor tax (FCT) withholding regime using the payer's TIN, unless the contractor independently registers under the same FCT procedure.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation. A resident foreign-invested LLC is a per se Vietnamese corporate income tax and VAT taxpayer; no pass-through/transparent treatment is available. Territorial scope: resident LLCs are taxed on worldwide income; non-resident suppliers are taxed only on Viet Nam-source income. Tax-exempt-zone status is not automatic and arises only from an investment incentive certificate under the Law on Investment with specific conditions.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Viet Nam does not provide a US-style check-the-box election, a partnership-style pass-through election, or a domestic hybrid-mismatch pass-through election. The LLC is automatically classified as an entity-level CIT taxpayer. Available statutory elections are limited to: (i) VAT computation method election between the credit method and the direct-calc-on-turnover method where law allows; (ii) registration of investment incentives (high-tech, supporting industry, special economic zones, export-processing enterprises) in the Investment Registration Certificate; (iii) application for an Advance Pricing Agreement for transfer pricing; and (iv) treaty-based relief under relevant double tax agreements. Anti-hybrid mismatches are addressed by substance-of-arrangement standards under transfer-pricing/anti-abuse rules, not by an election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) (Thuế Giá Trị Gia Tăng); central VAT system, no provincial sales/use tax layer.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: For an LLC, no VAT registration threshold applies; all corporate taxpayers must be VAT/TIN registered before carrying on taxable activity. For household/individual business taxpayers, annual turnover of VND 100,000,000 or less from VAT-able goods/services is exempt from VAT and triggers no registration/payment obligation. Non-resident foreign contractors without a PE are not separately VAT-registered unless they elect direct registration; the Vietnamese customer/beneficiary withholds foreign contractor VAT at the statutory rate.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: All taxable supplies must be supported by e-invoices in the GDT XML format (Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and Circular 78/2021/TT-BTC). E-invoices are signed by qualified digital signatures; physical stamping is abolished. Where the e-invoice uses a tax authority code/transaction code, the invoice is cleared through the GDT e-invoice portal in near-real-time before/at issuance; code-less e-invoices must be transmitted to the GDT within the prescribed periodic schedule. API/portal integration is mandatory for large sellers, and all taxpayers must maintain invoice records on the GDT system to support VAT refunds and zero-rating claims.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A 0% VAT rate is available for (i) exported goods physically leaving Viet Nam for consumption abroad, evidenced by a customs export declaration; and (ii) exported services supplied to foreign organizations/individuals and consumed entirely outside Viet Nam. For an offshore discretionary asset protection trust, zero-rating applies only if the trust is non-resident, the administration service is provided under a written offshore service contract, payment is received in foreign currency from abroad, and no benefit/use is enjoyed in Viet Nam. Services performed or consumed in Viet Nam, and transactions with domestic parties, remain taxable at 10% (or exempt if classified as financial/credit services). Financial/fiduciary services that are VAT-exempt do not enjoy input VAT creditability and cannot also be zero-rated; therefore classification under Circular 219/2013/TT-BTC as either an exempt financial service or an export service determines the outcome.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (electronic export declaration, customs e-system) evidencing goods passing out of Viet Nam (for goods exports)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill showing delivery/offshore destination
Inward Remittance Certificate from a licensed commercial bank in Viet Nam evidencing receipt of foreign currency from the foreign buyer/offshore trust
Export sales contract or offshore service agreement with the non-resident trust/beneficiary
Commercial invoice and packing list (goods) or service invoice/time-sheet certification (services)
Copy of the zero-rated e-invoice issued under Decree 123/2020/ND-CP and associated bank SWIFT/payment records
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Viet Nam's GDT and Customs cross-match export declarations, bills of lading, e-invoices, bank receipts and FX remittance records. If a zero-rated export or VAT refund cannot be substantiated, the refund is clawed back in full with late-payment interest at 0.03% per day, and administrative penalties apply under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP up to three times the evaded tax. Where false invoices, forged customs documents, or non-existent exports are used, criminal prosecution may follow under Article 200 of the Penal Code (VAT/tax fraud), particularly when the evaded tax exceeds VND 100,000,000. The 180-day foreign-exchange repatriation deadline is a specific compliance condition; missing it (absent lawful extension) exposes the taxpayer to FX-control sanctions and recapture of the VAT refund. The taxpayer bears the burden of proving offshore consumption, actual export, and payment repatriation.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (Báo cáo tình hình thay đổi doanh nghiệp) submitted via National Business Registration Portal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Department of Planning and Investment (DPI) / Business Registration Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days from the date of the company's fiscal year-end (annually by March 31 for calendar-year companies)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing fines from VND 1,000,000 to VND 3,000,000 (approx. USD 40–120); continued non-filing triggers company deregistration or strike-off by the DPI and tax authority for inactive enterprises.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Corporate Income Tax Finalization Return (Quyết toán thuế TNDN) and Financial Statements package
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation (GDT) / local tax sub-department and DPI (for audited financial statements)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: No later than the 90th day after the end of the fiscal year; for calendar-year companies, by March 31
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment interest at 0.03% per day on unpaid tax; late filing penalties up to VND 25,000,000 (approx. USD 1,000) depending on delay tier; persistent non-filing results in forced tax assessment and administrative suspension of tax invoice issuance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Enterprise Registration Information Declaration (Báo cáo tình hình kinh doanh) for foreign-invested LLCs
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: By the 30th day of the first quarter of the following calendar year (January 30 or within 30 days from the date of issuance of the annual report request)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fine from VND 3,000,000 to VND 5,000,000 (approx. USD 120–200) for failure to submit; repeat violation may lead to revocation of the Enterprise Registration Certificate or investment license.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) annual withholding declaration and finalization (if applicable to cross-border trust fees)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Department of Taxation / local tax sub-department
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: FCT declaration within 20 days of first payment or registration deadline; finalization within 90 days after fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Penalty of 20% of under-remitted FCT amount plus late interest at 0.03% per day; repeated violations subject to criminal referral in cases of willful evasion exceeding VND 100 million.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Foreign-invested LLCs are generally required to undergo an independent annual audit. Entities with 100% foreign ownership, trust/fiduciary service providers, or any enterprise above small-scale thresholds (total assets above VND 50 billion, annual revenue above VND 100 billion, or employing over 50 employees) must submit audited financial statements to the DPI and tax authority.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Vietnamese Accounting Standards (VAS) as issued under Circular 200/2014/TT-BTC; wholly foreign-invested entities may also report under IFRS for consolidated purposes if the parent requires, with statutory VAS financial statements still mandated for local filing.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Annual confirmation of ultimate beneficial owners is submitted as part of the Annual Enterprise Registration Information Declaration. Foreign-invested LLC acting as a discretionary asset protection trust administrator must identify any natural person (direct/indirect shareholding, voting control, or senior management authority) with ownership exceeding 25% or substantive control; changes in shareholding or UBO status must be reported to the DPI within 15 days of the change in addition to annual reconfirmation.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors / Members’ Council or Company President
Register of Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) filings

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 800–3,500 per year for a small/medium LLC; higher for trust/fiduciary complexity

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Standard corporate income tax rate for a foreign-invested limited liability company is 20% of taxable profit. No statutory CIT holiday applies automatically to fiduciary administration of asset-protection trusts under ISIC 6430. Preferential rates of 17%, 15%, or 10% and 2-to-4-year exemptions plus 4-to-9-year 50% reductions may be available only where the taxpayer holds a valid Investment Registration Certificate for an eligible sector, high-technology project, supporting industry, or severely disadvantaged geographical area, and such incentives do not extend to passive fee income outside the registered eligible activity.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Annual CIT Finalization Return - Form 02/TNDN (Tờ khai quyết toán thuế TNDN) filed electronically through the National Tax Portal / eTax (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn) with the managing provincial Department of Taxation for the foreign-invested LLC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than the 90th day after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year company this is 31 March. The fiscal year-end may be adjusted only with prior tax authority approval.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxpayer identification number, Investment Registration Certificate number, legal representative details, registered address, main business line (ISIC 6430 trust and fiduciary administration), and fiscal year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide full name, passport or corporate registration number of the foreign legal representative or non-resident member; include the foreign trust or settlor as a beneficial owner in additional declarations where required by the tax authority.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total revenue after VAT, including fiduciary management fees, trust administration commissions, deposit and execution fees, and any Vietnamese-sourced income derived from the trust asset vehicle.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Accrue revenue on the basis of signed trust deeds and service agreements; revenue denominated in foreign currency is converted at the interbank average exchange rate on the date of income recognition.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expenses actually incurred with lawful invoices, vouchers, and contracts, allocated to the generation of assessable revenue; statutory caps on advertising, entertainment, and management fees apply; donations and provisions exceeding statutory thresholds are non-deductible.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Recharges paid to an offshore trustee or trust administrator are deductible only where the contract is substantiated, services are actually performed, payment is made through a banking institution, and the foreign contractor tax obligations for the payee are settled.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prior-year tax losses carried forward chronologically and offset against assessable income, limited to 5 consecutive years.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Loss carry-forward belongs to the Vietnamese LLC and is not transferred with ownership interests; a change in non-resident members or trust beneficiaries does not reset the 5-year clock.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final CIT assessed after incorporating provisional quarterly payments, preferential tax rate adjustment, and additional tax payable or refundable.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: After-tax profit may be remitted abroad only after the audited financial statements are completed and the CIT finalization return is filed; profit remittance by a corporate member is not subject to dividend withholding tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalties under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP: VND 2,000,000 to 5,000,000 for 1 to 30 days late; VND 5,000,000 to 8,000,000 for 31 to 60 days; VND 8,000,000 to 15,000,000 for 61 to 90 days; VND 15,000,000 to 25,000,000 for more than 90 days. Any late or underestimated payment also attracts late-payment interest at 0.03% per day on the outstanding tax amount.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Quarterly Provisional CIT Return - Form 01/TNDN (Tờ khai thuế TNDN tạm tính) filed through eTax (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No later than the 30th day of the first month of the following quarter: 30 April for Q1, 30 July for Q2, 30 October for Q3, and 30 January for Q4 of the subsequent year.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Estimated quarterly taxable profit multiplied by the company's applicable CIT rate, with adjustments for incentives and non-deductible expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provisional tax must be based on a conservative annual projection; quarterly declarations do not need to be exact but total advance payments must reach at least 80% of the final CIT liability.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cumulative revenue and deductible expenses to the end of the reporting quarter, using the matching principle.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the LLC receives trust income on behalf of an offshore discretionary beneficiary under a deposition contract, such sums must be recorded as fiduciary liabilities rather than revenue unless risk of ownership has passed to the LLC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: The amount payable in cash to the state budget, determined as the difference between the cumulative tax due and prior quarterly advances.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Advance payments must be completed by the annual deadline; underpayment beyond the 80% threshold triggers penalty interest and statutory underestimation penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late quarterly filing attracts the same tiered fixed penalties as the annual return under Decree 125/2020/ND-CP. If the taxpayer pays less than 80% of the final CIT through provisional returns, the shortfall is treated as deficient payment and subjected to late-payment interest at 0.03% per day plus an administration penalty of up to 20% of the under-declared tax.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Related-Party Transaction Disclosure Attachment - Form 03-7/TNDN submitted together with the annual CIT finalization through eTax (thuedientu.gdt.gov.vn).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Same as the annual CIT finalization deadline: no later than 90 days after the fiscal year-end.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identifies the taxpayer, global organisation chart, related parties, transfer-pricing legal entity details, and total revenue plus total related-party transaction value.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign trust protectors, settlors, beneficiaries, and offshore corporate trustees must be included as related parties where they are able to control or substantially influence the VN LLC's pricing, funding, or commercial decisions.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Lists loans, royalties, management services, fiduciary fees, and sale or recharging arrangements with related parties, including contract value, price basis, and accounting policy.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For each controlled trust-administration transaction, state the day-to-day functions, assets, and risks of the Vietnamese LLC under the arm's length principle; do not characterise discretionary distribution decisions outside Vietnam as Vietnamese-source services.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part III - Arm's length method and comparables
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: States the transfer-pricing method chosen, comparable data, adjustment calculation, and reasons why the method provides the most reliable arm's length result.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offshore comparables must be adjusted for jurisdiction, exchange rates, functional profile, and lack of economically relevant local substance; reliance on publicly available MNE pricing databases without local documentation is insufficient.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Failure to attach Form 03-7/TNDN where related-party transactions exist attracts fixed penalties from VND 8,000,000 to VND 15,000,000 plus possible recharacterisation by the tax authority. A TP adjustment may result in additional CIT, late-payment interest at 0.03% per day, and penalties of up to 20% of the additional tax found after inspection.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: Corporate non-resident member distributions: 0% dividend withholding tax (CIT) on after-tax profits remitted by a Vietnamese LLC to a foreign corporate shareholder. Profit remittance is permitted only after audited financial statements, full CIT payment, and tax finalisation. Non-resident individual shareholders receiving profit distributions are subject to a final 5% personal income tax withheld at source, unless a treaty rate reduces that liability.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke a Double Tax Agreement: (1) the foreign beneficial owner obtains an official Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) from its residence jurisdiction; (2) the VN LLC files the treaty relief application and supporting forms prescribed under Circular 80/2021/TT-BTC through the eTax portal before the payment date; (3) the non-resident party provides a beneficial-ownership statement and underlying trust, loan, or royalty contracts; and (4) the Vietnamese tax authority notifies the payer of the accepted reduced rate or exemption. If domestic-rate tax was already withheld, a refund application may be pursued in the same procedural framework; all treaty position papers must be retained for at least 10 years.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic Foreign Contractor Tax (FCT) for payments to non-residents not operating through a PE in Vietnam: interest paid to a non-resident lender is subject to deemed CIT withholding at 5% and is VAT-exempt; royalties and licence fees paid to a non-resident IP owner are subject to deemed CIT withholding at 10% plus 5% deemed VAT, giving a combined 15% burden when VAT is not creditable. Tax treaties signed by Vietnam commonly reduce interest and royalty withholding to 5%, 7%, or 10%, subject to beneficial ownership and the treaty relief protocol above; specific rates depend on the governing DTA.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Under Decree 132/2020/ND-CP, a Vietnamese LLC is exempt from preparing the Local File and Master File if its annual revenue is below VND 50 billion and its total value of related-party transactions is below VND 30 billion. If either threshold is exceeded, contemporaneous Local File and Master File documentation is compulsory. A Country-by-Country Report is required only where the ultimate parent group of the foreign-invested LLC has consolidated revenue of at least VND 6,800 billion for the preceding fiscal year. Related-party transaction disclosures on Form 03-7/TNDN remain mandatory regardless of the documentation threshold.
